strings.name: Thomas Piketty
strings.summary: Born in Clichy and trained in mathematics and economics, Piketty studies income, capital and wealth distribution. With international collaborators he built comparative historical tax data; Capital in the Twenty-First Century brought inequality to public debate. He stresses capital returns relative to economic growth and advocates progressive taxation. His methods, interpretations and policies remain academically debated.
